experienceItems.description:
• Collaborated on the architectural design and implementation of a dedicated authentication microservice using Python, Django, and Django REST Framework.
• Developed and optimized main application microservice functionalities, focusing on automation and performance enhancements to streamline backend processes.
• Engineered full-stack Backstage plugins (Backend & Frontend) using TypeScript and React to enable entity review capabilities within the developer portal.
• Create Backstage frontend plugin using TypeScript and React to display products data and documentation utilizing main application microservice.
• Writing unit tests in pytest and Jest.
• Utilizing AI tools like Github Copilot in daily work.

• Designed and implemented a dedicated microservice for tutorial creation, leveraging Python, Django, Django REST Framework, Celery, Redis and Amazon S3.
• Improved performance of main application microservice by reducing database queries and code optimizations.
• Writing unit tests in pytest.

• Implement data import from Comarch ERP Optima database to Python backend developed with Django.
• Adjust Django Admin panel to work as financial system for handling company invoices, data exports, reports generations, etc.
• Cooperation with financial departments and management in determining the required functionalities in the system,
• Application maintenance and technical support.
